verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a synchronous real-time authorization webhook for approve/decline decisions, plus ML risk scores on every authorization. Its spending controls key on merchant category, merchant ID, country and card presence, which implies merchant category and presence context is available at authorization time. However, the evidence never documents the authorization payload fields themselves. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of merchant name/MCC fields on the authorization object, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details on authorizations, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals, and independent corroboration.
